candidates.statement: [\[BT\]](#BT){reference-type="ref" reference="BT"} can also be used to analyze the asymptotic behavior of the eigenvalues $\lambda^{(n)}_1 \le \lambda^{(n)}_2 \le \dots \le \lambda^{(n)}_n$, $n\to\infty$, of a Toeplitz matrix $T_n(\varphi)$ with a real symbol $\varphi$. At the beginning of our story (see Theorem [\[theorem2\]](#theorem2){reference-type="ref" reference="theorem2"}) we interpreted Szegő's early results as saying that the $\lambda^{(n)}_j$'s were equidistributed as $n\to\infty$.
